baseline.source: Read-Web isolated architecture and performance audit
baseline.method: Three isolated Chromium runs of all seven fixed browser journeys through a freshly started Local App Host and real capability sidecar on random loopback ports; every raw JSON and trace is retained per run
limitations: Three runs establish an initial local regression gate, not a cross-machine product SLA.
Each named measure currently has three samples; limits use the observed maximum plus an explicit 25% local variance allowance rounded up.
Vite dev cold-start remains diagnostic only; release enforcement measures the independent Local App Host over built dist assets.
Backend HTTP budgets remain independently enforced by the backend benchmark; this baseline gates browser journeys only.
activationRequirements: Retain every automated fixed-fixture raw sample and trace.
Fingerprint the machine, build, git SHA, fixture, frontend host, backend host, and runtime configuration.
Separate cold-start and warm-start distributions and calculate p50, p95, and max from repeated runs.
Capture Long Task, console, page, request, HTTP, and unhandled-rejection evidence in the same run.
Re-baseline only through an explicit reviewed config change that preserves previous artifacts.
